MRT Music Kannada presents "Haalu Jenu Ondaada Haage" Lyrical Video Song from Haalu Jenu Old Kannada Movie, Ft Dr.Rajkumar, Madhavi, Roopa Devi. Sung By Dr.Rajkumar, Music Composed By G. K. Venkatesh, Directed By Dorai-Bhagavan.
Movie: Haalu Jenu
Directed by: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Madhavi, Roopa Devi
Music Director: G. K. Venkatesh
Cinematography: S. V. Srikanth
Song: Haalu Jenu Ondaada Haage
